blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: Most households do well with a 1/2 or 3/4 horsepower disposal. More power grinds finer and jams less. Stainless steel parts last longer. A sound-insulated model is quieter, which matters in an open kitchen. If your dishwasher drains through the disposal, we'll make sure the new one has the right connection and the knockout plug is removed.

blocks.h2: What Affects the Price of a Disposal Job
blocks.body: The disposal itself is one part. The rest depends on what's under the sink: whether there's an outlet, whether the drain lines up and whether the dishwasher connects through it. A straight swap is quick. A first-time install may need an outlet and drain changes. We look first and quote one flat price.

blocks.h2: Garbage Disposal Questions From Elmhurst Homeowners

items.q: Can you install a disposal where there wasn't one?
items.answer: Usually. We may need to add an outlet and adjust the drain.

items.q: My disposal hums. What should I do?
items.preview: Turn it off. It's probably jammed.
items.answer: Turn it off. Try the reset button and the hex key under the unit. If it won't turn, call us.

items.q: Should I repair or replace it?
items.preview: If it leaks from the body or is old, replace it.
items.answer: If the housing leaks or it's over about 10 years old, replacing it usually makes more sense.

items.q: What shouldn't go in a disposal?
items.preview: Grease, bones, fibrous food and coffee grounds.
items.answer: Grease, bones, fibrous foods, eggshells and coffee grounds cause most problems.

items.preview: A plug inside the dishwasher inlet.
items.answer: A plug inside a new disposal's dishwasher inlet. It must be removed if the dishwasher connects there.

items.q: Why does my disposal leak from the bottom?
items.answer: A leak from the bottom of the unit usually means an internal seal has failed. That can't be repaired, so the disposal needs replacing.

items.q: Can a disposal go in a kitchen island sink?
items.preview: Usually, with an outlet and proper venting.
items.answer: Usually. The island needs an outlet and a drain with proper venting. We'll check both.

items.q: How much does garbage disposal installation cost in Elmhurst?
items.preview: It depends on the unit. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the unit and the connections. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
